periods.label: Fri 6 Nov
periods.text: Variable about 10 knots becoming east to northeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day. Winds reaching up to 20 knots north of Moruya Heads during the afternoon and evening. Around 1 metre. Southerly 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres north of Moruya Heads. Mostly sunny.

periods.label: Sat 7 Nov

Winds reaching up to 30 knots during the afternoon and evening. Squalls possible with the wind change. 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres around midday, then increasing to 2.5 to 3 metres during the afternoon. Southerly around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres around midday. Partly cloudy. 95% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon and evening.
